definition: Directional changes in TKA sequences where hands and/or props change their path or rotation direction.

handReversal.description: Hand returns to point it came from previously
handReversal.rotationEffect: Changes prospin to antispin and vice-versa (relative to center point)

propReversal.description: Hand continues to next point while prop reverses direction
propReversal.rotationEffect: Changes prospin to antispin and vice-versa
propReversal.notation: R/R added in corresponding color between pictographs

fullReversal.description: Both prop and hand retrace their paths to the previous placement

ACAC.requirement: Prop-reversals necessary when combining hybrid C with non-hybrid A

BCBC.pattern: Right hand prop-reversing after every beat

reversalPlacement.description: Reversal location in word leads to notably different outcomes
reversalPlacement.example: Same word (e.g., AABB) has multiple presentations depending on where reversals occur

reversalAlternation.complexity: Can use every reversal type in single sequence

mirroredLoops.description: Often use reversals to achieve mirroring
mirroredLoops.example: Reversal after beat 1, repeat mirrored with reversal after beat 5

bodyTurnIntegration.example: Beat 5 with right hand coming down on left side requires body turn
bodyTurnIntegration.planeSwitching: Move from wall plane to wheel plane via body turn
bodyTurnIntegration.purpose: Facilitates motion execution and rotational transitions

staticBeatReversals.description: Reversal with beat of no motion in between
staticBeatReversals.notation: Still mark with R for prop reversal indication
staticBeatReversals.example: BΔMX sequence with right hand stops on beats 2 and 4

thumbOrientationChanges.antispin: Ends swap orientation (in to out, out to in)
thumbOrientationChanges.dash: Thumb ends also swap orientation in base dash

executionRequirements.bodyTurns: Alternative to negative space for execution
